hack.root_cause: Flash Loan — Rebalancing Delay Pool Oracle Manipulation
hack.description: An attacker used flash loans to manipulate Indexed Finance's pool oracle by 99.97%, tricking the protocol into valuing $100M+ in assets at $300k, then minted inflated index tokens and drained $16M from three pools.
